from pypdf import PdfReader
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from openai import OpenAI
import numpy as np

text = " ".join(p.extract_text() or "" for p in PdfReader("{{pdf_path}}").pages)
chunks = [text[i:i+800] for i in range(0, len(text), 700)]
emb = SentenceTransformer("{{embed_model}}")
vecs = emb.encode(chunks, normalize_embeddings=True)
llm = OpenAI()

def ask(q: str) -> str:
    qv = emb.encode([q], normalize_embeddings=True)
    top = np.argsort(-(vecs @ qv.T).flatten())[:4]
    ctx = "\n".join(chunks[i] for i in top)
    r = llm.chat.completions.create(model="{{model_name}}",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Ctx:\n{ctx}\nQ: {q}"}])
    return r.choices[0].message.content

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys; print(ask(" ".join(sys.argv[1:])))
